title: EMS Alarm Manager Configuration
description: Alarm thresholds and rules for the alarm_manager. Defines per-signal high/low thresholds, severity levels, hysteresis, and enable/disable control. This schema is hot-reloadable per IEC 62682 requirements — threshold changes take effect without service restart. Fields marked x-mutable: true can be updated at runtime.

_schema_version.description: Schema version for migration detection. Must match the schema expected version.

defaults.description: Default alarm parameters applied when individual alarm rules do not specify their own values. Reduces configuration repetition across large alarm sets.

hysteresis_pct.description: Default hysteresis band as percentage of threshold value. Prevents alarm chattering near threshold boundary. Example: 2% means alarm clears when signal returns to 2% below the trigger threshold.

delay_ms.description: Default alarm activation delay. Signal must exceed threshold for this duration before alarm activates. Filters transient spikes.

rules.description: Named alarm rules for each monitored signal. Each rule defines the RTDB signal path, severity, thresholds, and activation parameters.

cell_voltage_high.description: Alarm rule for individual cell overvoltage condition. High cell voltage indicates overcharge risk — protection trip prevents cell damage.

signal.description: RTDB signal path for this alarm. Example: bms.cell_voltage_max

severity.description: IEC 62682 alarm severity. 'warning' = operator attention; 'action' = immediate operator action; 'protection' = automatic protective action.

high_threshold.description: Signal value above which this alarm activates. For cell voltage: typically 3.65V (LFP overcharge threshold).

low_threshold.description: Signal value below which this alarm activates (for low-side alarms). Optional for high-only alarm rules.

hysteresis.description: Hysteresis band for this alarm rule. Overrides the global default if set.

delay_ms.description: Activation delay for this alarm rule in milliseconds. Overrides the global default if set.

enabled.description: Enable or disable this alarm rule. Disabled alarms are suppressed and will not appear in the active alarm list.

cell_voltage_low.description: Alarm rule for individual cell undervoltage condition. Low cell voltage indicates deep discharge risk — protection trip prevents irreversible cell damage.

signal.description: RTDB signal path for this alarm.

high_threshold.description: Upper threshold. Not typically used for undervoltage alarms.

low_threshold.description: Signal value below which undervoltage alarm activates. For LFP cells: typically 2.8V.

hysteresis.description: Hysteresis band for this alarm rule.

delay_ms.description: Activation delay for this alarm rule in milliseconds.

enabled.description: Enable or disable this alarm rule.

cell_temp_high.description: Alarm rule for cell overtemperature condition. High cell temperature degrades cycle life and can lead to thermal runaway — action alarm triggers cooling increase.

signal.description: RTDB signal path for this alarm.

high_threshold.description: Temperature above which this alarm activates. Typical LFP high temp action: 45°C.

low_threshold.description: Lower threshold. Not typically used for overtemperature alarms.

hysteresis.description: Hysteresis band for this alarm rule.

delay_ms.description: Activation delay for this alarm rule in milliseconds.

enabled.description: Enable or disable this alarm rule.

cell_temp_low.description: Alarm rule for cell undertemperature condition. Low cell temperature increases internal resistance and reduces available capacity — action alarm triggers heating.

signal.description: RTDB signal path for this alarm.

high_threshold.description: Upper threshold. Not typically used for undertemperature alarms.

low_threshold.description: Temperature below which undertemperature alarm activates. Charging below 0°C causes lithium plating.

hysteresis.description: Hysteresis band for this alarm rule.

delay_ms.description: Activation delay for this alarm rule in milliseconds.

enabled.description: Enable or disable this alarm rule.

soc_high.description: Alarm rule for battery SOC approaching or exceeding charge cutoff. Warning before the hardware protection limit triggers.

signal.description: RTDB signal path for this alarm.

high_threshold.description: SOC above which this alarm activates. Typical: 98% (warning before 100% hardware protection).

low_threshold.description: Lower SOC threshold. Not typically used for high-SOC alarms.

hysteresis.description: Hysteresis band for this alarm rule.

delay_ms.description: Activation delay for this alarm rule in milliseconds.

enabled.description: Enable or disable this alarm rule.

soc_low.description: Alarm rule for battery SOC approaching or reaching discharge cutoff. Protection alarm prevents deep discharge damage.

signal.description: RTDB signal path for this alarm.

high_threshold.description: Upper SOC threshold. Not typically used for low-SOC alarms.

low_threshold.description: SOC below which protection alarm activates. Typical: 5% (hard limit, triggers discharge cutoff).

hysteresis.description: Hysteresis band for this alarm rule.

delay_ms.description: Activation delay for this alarm rule in milliseconds.

enabled.description: Enable or disable this alarm rule.

pcs_overtemp.description: Alarm rule for PCS inverter overtemperature. High internal temperature in the PCS can trigger thermal derating or shutdown.

signal.description: RTDB signal path for this alarm.

high_threshold.description: PCS internal temperature above which this alarm activates. Typical: 75°C.

low_threshold.description: Lower temperature threshold. Not typically used for overtemperature alarms.

hysteresis.description: Hysteresis band for this alarm rule.

delay_ms.description: Activation delay for this alarm rule in milliseconds.

enabled.description: Enable or disable this alarm rule.

bus_voltage_high.description: Alarm rule for DC bus overvoltage. High bus voltage above rated maximum can damage PCS and battery terminals.

signal.description: RTDB signal path for this alarm.

high_threshold.description: DC bus voltage above which protection alarm activates. Typical: 600V for 500V-class BESS.

low_threshold.description: Lower voltage threshold. Not typically used for overvoltage alarms.

hysteresis.description: Hysteresis band for this alarm rule.

delay_ms.description: Activation delay for this alarm rule in milliseconds.

enabled.description: Enable or disable this alarm rule.

bus_voltage_low.description: Alarm rule for DC bus undervoltage. Low bus voltage below PCS minimum operating range prevents inverter operation.

signal.description: RTDB signal path for this alarm.

high_threshold.description: Upper voltage threshold. Not typically used for undervoltage alarms.

low_threshold.description: DC bus voltage below which protection alarm activates. Typical: 400V for 500V-class BESS.

hysteresis.description: Hysteresis band for this alarm rule.

delay_ms.description: Activation delay for this alarm rule in milliseconds.

enabled.description: Enable or disable this alarm rule.
